entities.name: José Gregorio Valera
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Gregorio Valera was the president of Venezuela from 15 December 1878 to 13 February 1879. He was a half brother of his predecessor Francisco Linares Alcántara. He was overthrown by the general José Gregorio Cedeño, who proclaimed the new president of the country the former president Antonio Guzmán Blanco.

entities.summary: José Gregorio Valera was the president of Venezuela from 15 December 1878 to 13 February 1879. He was a half brother of his predecessor Francisco Linares Alcántara. He was overthrown by the general José Gregorio Cedeño, who proclaimed the new president of the country the former president Antonio Guzmán Blanco.
